cases.prompt: Set up RFProteína on this machine and confirm it can run. Install the environment, download the example checkpoints into a local DATA_PATH, run the setup preflight, and then run a single-design smoke test on the short monomer benchmark.
expected_behavior: Sets CLUSTER=local and DATA_PATH, creates .ipd/.env.local, runs scripts/download_example_data.sh
Runs python src/rfproteina/generate.py inputs=data/benchmarks/monomer.json subset_to_examples=monomer-short num_replicates=1 out_dir=./runs/smoke
Handles the checkpoint-name mismatch by overriding ckpt_name if only example data was downloaded
